name: bitcorn-lightning-application
description: Root-level dev orchestration for the Bitcorn Lightning app. The app itself lives in app/api, app/web, and cloudflare-worker — see docs/dev-setup.md for how to run all three locally against a Polar regtest network.

scripts._comment_loop_layer: Optional Loop fidelity layer scripts. loopserver runs as a Docker container, pinned to lightninglabs/loopserver:v0.9.221-beta (Lightning Labs publishes it only as an image — there is no Go source for it in lightninglabs/loop). loopd runs as a native binary built from lightninglabs/loop v0.33.0-beta. See docs/dev-setup.md § Optional: Loop Fidelity Layer for setup details.
